package.name: replay
package.description: Replay input device for the SOT handoff bundle (RobotSTAR_demos): publishes a sample's G1 arm joint targets and 21-point hand keypoints as topics, so the existing output controllers (g1_world_output joint_replay mode, wujihand_controller keypoints_topic source) can drive the robot or the MuJoCo sim from recorded motion instead of live teleop.
